items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 46:1
items.html: The hairs too are divided into thirteen aspects, according to the three HaVaYaHs and the one that includes them all, as in Answer 20 above, see there. And they are called the thirteen strands of hair, and 'strand' (Nima) means a group of hairs. (Page 365, Item 148).
